claims.statement: If sum_i v_i v_i^T=I_2 and ||v_i||^2<=1/2, there is an original-index partition J,K with det(S_J)det(S_K)>=1/640; in particular each S_G has lambda_min>=1/640.
For independent cap-one original coordinates, the two disjoint transverse packets furnished by the partition theorem are independent and each has a joint R^2 density bounded by e*sqrt(640)<68.768.

For arbitrary symmetric A with s_3(A)>=1, selected three-large-eigenspace leverage c at coordinate i, a=A_ii, b=A_(i,-i), C=A_(-i,-i), one has ||b||^2>=c-a^2 and ||C||op>=1. Hence c>=7/9 and |a|<=1/4 imply ||b||>=sqrt(103)/12.
If additionally some j has |A_ij|>=1/2 and |A_jj|<=1/4, then ||p_(X^TAX)||infinity<49 for all arbitrary independent cap-one inputs.

near_zero_unpaid_implication: Combine the full-matrix star lower bound and complementary operator-norm resource without treating near-zero as exact zero; remaining branch has a diffuse star or all large star atoms supported on diagonals >1/4.
